findings.fix: Distinguish the literal athletes' perishable wreath from the imperishable comparison, and do not misassign2Timothy's first-person crown to Timothy the recipient.
findings.before: The imperishable wreath sought by the competitors is comparable to Timothy's promised crown of righteousness after the fight/course. Corinthians contrasts perishable and imperishable awards; Timothy names the righteous Judge and all who loved His appearing, rather than using the same self-control formulation.
findings.after: The earthly competitors seek a perishable wreath, whereas Paul describes an imperishable one. In2Timothy the first-person speaker expects a crown of righteousness after finishing the course, awarded by the Lord also to all who loved His appearing. The award imagery corresponds, but the selected target does not repeat Corinthians' self-control instruction.
findings.resolution: Applied directly to the latest final primary, and to the matching8–9 preview when within its prefix; no pair identity, source disposition or count changed.

findings.fix: Make the objects and instrument of Deuteronomy's jealousy response explicit instead of the ambiguous counter-jealousy against a nation.
findings.before: Deuteronomy explicitly describes God's jealousy and anger provoked by what is no god and by idols. Corinthians asks whether the readers are provoking the Lord to jealousy and whether they are stronger. The divine counter-jealousy against a nation in Deuteronomy is not inserted into Paul's shorter questions.
findings.after: Deuteronomy explicitly describes God's jealousy and anger provoked by what is no god and by idols. Corinthians asks whether the readers are provoking the Lord to jealousy and whether they are stronger. Deuteronomy's additional response, making them jealous with a no-nation and provoking them through a nation without understanding, is not inserted into Paul's shorter questions.
findings.resolution: Applied directly to the latest final primary, and to the matching8–9 preview when within its prefix; no pair identity, source disposition or count changed.
